setup: for path in .claude .jactignore .mcp.json .pi .scratch .vscode design-docs .env .env.local .env.development.local .env.test.local .env.production.local; do if { [ -e "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/$path" ] || [ -L "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/$path" ]; } && [ ! -e "$path" ] && [ ! -L "$path" ]; then ln -s "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/$path" "$path"; fi; done
